precepts.text: Another beast coming up out of the earth with two horns like a lamb: the two horns are the two political parties, Democrats and Republicans. And he spake as a dragon.
precepts.point: Which go forth unto the kings of the earth and of the whole world: it's not just domestic, it's global. And gather them to the battle of the great day of God Almighty.

note.label: Popular Persuasions: Fighting Against Heaven Defending Earth

precepts.why:
The three unclean spirits like frogs come “out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet.” Those three unclean spirits are politics, religion and finance. To see the first of them, go to the beast of Revelation 13.

John says, “I beheld another beast coming up out of the earth; and he had two horns like a lamb, and he spake as a dragon.” Those two horns like a lamb are the two political parties, the Democrats and the Republicans: two political systems that look gentle like a lamb. But he speaks as a dragon.

That is the politics, the frog that comes out of the mouth of the dragon. And what comes out of a mouth? Communication, and that communication is propaganda, persuasion and lies. These are “the spirits of devils”, and they do not stay at home: they “go forth unto the kings of the earth and of the whole world”, gathering them “to the battle of that great day of God Almighty.”

precepts.text: That no man might buy or sell: that's the finance, one of the three frogs. It's coming to a time where, if you are not in allegiance with what America pushes, you will not be able to buy or sell. On a large scale that's trade, but it's also regular buying and selling. That's why they're trying to do away with the currency and bring everything into a digital system, to monitor God's people who speak up against society.
precepts.point: Which go forth unto the kings of the earth and of the whole world: it's not just domestic, it's global. And gather them to the battle of the great day of God Almighty.

note.label: Popular Persuasions: Fighting Against Heaven Defending Earth

precepts.why:
The second frog comes “out of the mouth of the beast.” Go back to Revelation 13: “he causeth all, both small and great, rich and poor, free and bond, to receive a mark in their right hand, or in their foreheads: And that no man might buy or sell, save he that had the mark, or the name of the beast, or the number of his name.”

That no man might buy or sell: that is the finance, one of the three unclean spirits like frogs, alongside the politics and the religion.

It is coming to a time where, if you are not in cahoots with, in support of, or in allegiance with what America pushes, you will not be able to buy or sell. On a large scale that is trade between nations, but it is also the regular buying and selling of everyday life. That is why they are trying to do away with the currency as it is now and bring everything into a digital system: to monitor God's people who speak up against this society.

The third frog, out of the mouth of the false prophet, is Christianity, their religion and their religious systems. Politics, finance and religion together are the spirits of devils working miracles, going out to the kings of the whole world, not only here at home.

precepts.text: Worms rose up out of the body of this wicked man Antiochus, his flesh fell away, and the filthiness of his smell was noisome to all his army. That is what noisome looks like in the record.
precepts.point: The key thing: the sore falls on the people that worship the image of the beast and have his mark. If it is only them, where are we? We are delivered.
precepts.why:
The first vial brings “a noisome and grievous sore.” Noisome means foul smelling, harmful, noxious, extremely offensive to the senses, particularly the smell: a real nasty sore. It is the same plague that came on ancient Egypt, a boil breaking forth upon man and upon beast throughout all the land.

The record shows what noisome looks like on a man. When the Lord struck the wicked king Antiochus, “the worms rose up out of the body of this wicked man, and whiles he lived in sorrow and pain, his flesh fell away, and the filthiness of his smell was noisome to all his army.” His flesh fell off him and his stink offended his whole army.

What could make a man get like that? A nuclear bomb explosion causes severe radiation burns, known as cutaneous radiation injury, that frequently lead to intense itching, blistering and open sores. The burns come in stages: first redness and swelling, then a latent phase, then severe blistering and deep, long lasting necrotic ulcers. When a nuclear bomb goes off and the blast does not kill you, you are going to be rotten, your skin falling off, and it is going to be noisome.

That is how we know this first plague belongs to that one hour, when the destruction comes on America, modern day Egypt: the same kind of sore that ate Antiochus alive falls on the men who have the mark of the beast.

precepts.text: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the Most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty: his protection. Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, and from the noisome pestilence. That is the first plague, and the Lord will deliver us from it. In that one hour, when them bombs are falling, it is not going to come near us.
precepts.point: The key thing: the sore falls on the people that worship the image of the beast and have his mark. If it is only them, where are we? We are delivered.
precepts.why:
The key thing in the verse is who the sore falls on: “upon the men which had the mark of the beast, and upon them which worshipped his image.” If it is only them, where are we? What happened to us? We are delivered.

Psalms 91 explains why. “He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.” If you dwell in the secret place of the Most High, you dwell in his shadow, meaning his protection. “I will say of the Lord, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.”

“Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, and from the noisome pestilence.” That is the first plague, the noisome pestilence, and the Lord will deliver you from it. That is why the scripture says the plague fell only on those that worship the beast and have his mark: because we are delivered.

This plague is coming in that one hour, and in that one hour, when the bombs are falling, it is not going to come near us. The radioactive waves, the noisome pestilence, the poisoned water will not touch us, because the Lord is going to deliver us up out of here. The same pestilence that destroys America passes over the people who dwell under his shadow.

precepts.text: The seven angels pour out the vials of the wrath of God upon the earth, war and civil war among them; they poured some on Trump too, who is on a rampage against DEI, black history and citizenship because God put that spirit on him. May the Lord give him seven more years; if he is the one to fulfil God's will, let him stay.
precepts.point: I will bring plagues upon the world, the sword, famine, death and destruction, for wickedness hath exceedingly polluted the whole earth; I will hold my tongue no more as touching their wickedness. It starts with his spirit on us teaching, and then he comes back and deals with them.
precepts.why:
“And I heard a great voice out of the temple saying to the seven angels, Go your ways, and pour out the vials of the wrath of God upon the earth.” The Lord created spirits for vengeance, and here they are: the angels pouring out the wrath of God upon the earth. Read the whole chapter and it goes into war, civil war, all of it. Who is behind it? The Lord, doing it through the angels.

They just poured some of that vial upon Trump. He came into office: get rid of DEI hiring, no more affirmative action, get rid of black history, take away citizenship from a lot of y’all. The dude is on a rampage, because God put that spirit on him, and a lot of y’all got the American dream and think this place is your rest. Trump thinks he is doing something good, bringing peace, but he is really fulfilling God’s will: bringing affliction on all nations.

May the Lord give Trump seven more years. If he is the one to fulfil God’s will, let him stay in office, even if he is the one that starts putting us to death. Let God’s will be done. Impeach him and the next president will do the same thing, because it is God’s will.

That is 2 Esdras 15 in our day: “I will bring plagues upon the world.” The Lord is the one sending them, the angels are pouring them out, and America is the one he is using to bring death and war, the same way ancient Babylon was used against the nations.

precepts.text: The great city is spiritually called Sodom and Egypt.
precepts.point: The great city was divided into three parts before God gave her the cup of his wrath. Civil war comes first, then the great hail of nuclear destruction.

note.label: Civil War & the Son of Perdition

precepts.why:
“And the great city was divided into three parts”. What is the great city? Revelation 11:8 answers: “their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also our Lord was crucified.” That great city, spiritually Sodom and Egypt, is America.

So the great city was divided. Remember what Christ says: any kingdom divided against itself shall fall. Before God pours “the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath” on Babylon, something has to happen first: the great city is divided into three parts, “and the cities of the nations fell.” There will be civil war here first; then God is going to destroy this place.

The fifth vial comes before it: poured “upon the seat of the beast; and his kingdom was full of darkness”. The seat of the beast is America, and that darkness is not only sin, adultery and fornication. It is debt, sedition, division, civil war, violence, and the saints being killed here too. “They gnawed their tongues for pain, And blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores, and repented not of their deeds.” Their own citizens they are going to be killing, and still they will not repent.

Then “every island fled away, and the mountains were not found. And there fell upon men a great hail out of heaven”. That great hail is nuclear ballistic missiles, looking like hail coming down from heaven: America destroyed with nuclear destruction. So prepare for what is coming. Civil war is coming to this place.

precepts.text: The Carmanians shall come out of the woods in great fury.
precepts.point: Three unclean spirits come from the dragon, the beast and the false prophet: politics, the American financial system and Christianity. They gather the kings of the earth to battle.
precepts.why:
“And the sixth angel poured out his vial upon the great river Euphrates; and the water thereof was dried up”. The Euphrates runs from Iraq up through Syria to Turkey, and it is drying up right now, from severe droughts, with dams along it; whoever controls the water controls the agriculture. So don't tell us the Bible isn't true. We are in these days, the time is now. You won't read this in the Quran, the Gilgamesh epic or the Egyptian Book of the Dead; you only read it in the Bible.

Why is it dried up? So “that the way of the kings of the east might be prepared.” Ezra shows who the kings of the east are: “Behold an horrible vision, and the appearance thereof from the east: Where the nations of the dragons of Arabia shall come out with many chariots, and the multitude of them shall be carried as the wind upon earth, that all they which hear them may fear and tremble.” The dragons of Arabia are the Arabs.

“Also the Carmanians raging in wrath shall go forth as the wild boars of the wood, and with great power shall they come, and join battle with them, and shall waste a portion of the land of the Assyrians.” The Carmanians are Iran, the Iranians. And the land of the Assyrians here is Israel: they are going to waste a portion of the land of Israel.

Then come the three unclean spirits out of the mouth of the dragon, the beast and the false prophet: politics with NATO, the financial system of the United States, and Christianity. “For they are the spirits of devils, working miracles, which go forth unto the kings of the earth and of the whole world, to gather them to the battle of that great day of God Almighty.” Those three spirits, all coming from the white man, are leading to war on top of war like we have never seen, and the way is being prepared for the kings of the east.

precepts.text: The way of the kings of the east is prepared, and unclean spirits gather the kings of the earth to battle.
precepts.point: Babylon hath been a golden cup in the Lord's hand; the nations have drunken of her wine, therefore the nations are mad.
precepts.why:
“And the sixth angel poured out his vial upon the great river Euphrates; and the water thereof was dried up, that the way of the kings of the east might be prepared.” Prepared for what? Prepared for war.

Read on: “And I saw three unclean spirits like frogs come out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet.” The dragon is the white man. These three are their politics, their religion and their economics, unclean things going out of the mouth of Edom.

“For they are the spirits of devils, working miracles, which go forth unto the kings of the earth and of the whole world, to gather them”. Why are these things gathering the nations? Because they are oppression: America destroying people's economic systems, making war with nations, supporting the Israelis in the land over there, dropping bombs on Iran, going into Venezuela and kidnapping a standing president and calling him a drug dealer, saying it will take Greenland. These policies are the unclean things getting everybody around the world mad.

That is the madness of Jeremiah 51:7. The nations have drunk of Babylon's golden cup, and they are being gathered to battle because of what America has poured out on the earth.

precepts.text: The vials poured on the sea and the rivers until they became blood is the blood in that vision: death coming.
precepts.point: The destruction coming to America means the rebirth of the Israelite man and woman ruling on the earth, and that is what makes it a problem.

precepts.why: Some of us think that as soon as Christ returns the whole earth submits. “And they repented not to give him glory.” “And repented not of their deeds”: they are not changing their ways.

“And as it were a great mountain burning with fire was cast into the sea: and the third part of the sea became blood”: the same thing, the waters being poisoned. “And the third part of the creatures which were in the sea, and had life, died”: they destroyed the sea creatures, the fish. “And the third part of the ships were destroyed”: like the films about World War II where the ships on the water are blown up.

“And there fell a great star from heaven, burning as it were a lamp”: this great star is an ICBM. “And it fell upon the third part of the rivers, and upon the fountains of waters; And the name of the star is called Wormwood”: wormwood is like poison. When this missile hits the waters it is nuclear fallout, and it kills a lot in the oceans and seas. “And many men died of the waters, because they were made bitter”: made poisonous.

“I sent unto you my servants the prophets, whom ye have taken and slain, and torn their bodies in pieces, whose blood I will require of your hands, saith the Lord.” Hold that verse. We know who did this: wicked Israelites.

Christ says it about the Israelites: “O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, thou that killest the prophets, and stonest them which are sent unto thee, how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings, and ye would not!” He compares himself to the hen, and he is still talking about Jerusalem. Revelation 11 shows how this ties back to Babylon.

“And the beast which I saw was like unto a leopard”: the leopard in Daniel 7 was like the Greeks, so America took on attributes of the leopard, the Greek system. “And his feet were as the feet of a bear”: in Daniel 7 the Persian captivity was like a bear that raised itself up on one side, a dual empire, the Persians and the Medes. Likewise America has a dual political system, Republicans and Democrats: attributes of ancient Persia.

“And his mouth as the mouth of a lion”: in Daniel 7 the Babylonians, Nebuchadnezzar, had a mouth like a lion speaking great swelling things. That is America: we’re going to the moon, we’re going to make airplanes and automobiles and railroads, we are God. “And the dragon gave him his power, and his seat, and great authority”: no other nation on earth has authority like this place.

“And the woman which thou sawest is that great city”: the great city, Babylon the great, is represented in this parable as a woman. “Which reigneth over the kings of the earth”: that is America. China is not ruling over all the kings of the earth. Remember Donald Trump at the G8 summit pushing Europe out of the way to get in front of the picture: America first. People think America is weak; the Most High put him in power to show how strong America is. This is all prophecy.

The dragon’s mouth: “And I beheld another beast coming up out of the earth; and he had two horns like a lamb”: the two horns are the two-party political system, Republicans and Democrats. Like a lamb, because they say this is a Christian society: God bless us every one, in God we trust.

“And he spake as a dragon”: what do you speak with? Your mouth, their media. When they talk about freedom of religion, that is the dragon: if you want to worship the devil you have the right to. Those constitutional rights everybody brags about are against God. We use them so we can teach who we are, but in God’s kingdom there will be no freedom of religion.

“And he exerciseth all the power of the first beast before him”: Rome. “And causeth the earth and them which dwell therein to worship the first beast, whose deadly wound was healed”: Rome came back in power from the time of the Renaissance.

The mouth of the beast: “And he causeth all, both small and great, rich and poor, free and bond, to receive a mark in their right hand, or in their foreheads”: the mark is their policies. “And that no man might buy or sell”: another term for buying and selling on a global scale is commerce, trade. This ain’t talking about somebody buying a Snickers bar.

“Save he that had the mark”: their policies, “or the name of the beast, or the number of his name”: the number of destruction, 666, for another lesson. In Washington DC the IMF and the World Bank sit across the street from each other, and they dictate how much your money is worth. One American dollar gets five Haitian dollars, thirty in Uganda. All over Africa there is gold and diamonds and unbelievable wealth; the European countries reap the resources and then say your money ain’t worth nothing. France has no gold and no diamonds. This is what Revelation is going into.

The black horse goes into the same thing, buying and selling. “And he that sat on him had a pair of balances in his hand.” “A measure of wheat for a penny, and three measures of barley for a penny”: that is how much it weighs, how much it is worth. “And see thou hurt not the oil and the wine”: do not deal unjustly. What does Babylon do? They tip the scales in buying and selling depending on the nations they want to deal with.

The mouth of the false prophet is Christianity, their religions. “And deceiveth them that dwell on the earth by the means of those miracles”: the bombs. “That they should make an image to the beast, which had the wound by a sword, and did live”: that came from Rome, which fell in 193 AD and was resurrected in 1453, during the Renaissance. The image they came with was the image of Caesar Borgia, the second son of Pope Alexander VI of Rome.

“And he had power to give life unto the image of the beast”: the life they gave the image is the life of Christ. This is not Caesar Borgia anymore, it shall be known as Christ; ask anybody on the street who that white image is and they’ll say Jesus. “That the image of the beast should both speak”: it speaks in their media; they look for actors who resemble Caesar Borgia. “And cause that as many as would not worship the image of the beast should be killed”: when the conquistadors came, every Indian that would not worship that image was put to death; when they brought the slaves over, any of us that would not worship that white image was put to death. Today they say if you don’t worship white Jesus you’re going to hell.

“Remember therefore how thou hast received and heard, and hold fast, and repent”: remember how you received the understanding of these scriptures and how you heard it; hold fast to that, and repent. “If therefore thou shalt not watch”: if you will not watch the signs of the times, so occupied with entertainment you are watching nothing, “I will come on thee as a thief, and thou shalt not know what hour I will come upon thee.”

“Watch therefore, for ye know neither the day nor the hour wherein the Son of man cometh.” Pay attention to what is happening in the world. Read the scriptures, then search the news, and go outside the New York Times, the Daily News and the American news media in general.

“And when Moses saw that the people were naked; (for Aaron had made them naked unto their shame among their enemies:)”: to be naked means you are in the midst of sin. Aaron made them naked because he had just built a golden calf and Israel was worshipping it. Moses says they are naked to their shame, and that is the same thing John is saying about us.

A precept for watch. “But if the watchman see the sword come”: you see danger and judgment coming, “and blow not the trumpet, and the people be not warned; if the sword come”: the war, the danger, “and take any person from among them, he is taken away in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at the watchman’s hand.” The watchmen are the men teaching the Bible: God will require it at our hand if we saw the danger coming and said nothing. We have been warning for years that there would be infiltrations in the congregations to cause confusion.

“So thou, O son of man, I have set thee a watchman unto the house of Israel; therefore thou shalt hear the word at my mouth, and warn them from me.” We are watchmen to the house of Israel, and this class is another warning.

Keep your garments: “Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness; and let thy saints shout for joy.” The men and women who left this truth ran out naked, with no garments. In all that confusion nobody came to leadership; if it is a personal problem, the solution is Matthew 18. If there is a problem you apply the scriptures; you don’t run a social media video campaign. That is agent provocateur stuff.

What righteousness is: “And it shall be our righteousness, if we observe to do all these commandments before the Lord our God, as he hath commanded us.” Do the commandments. If you let somebody tell you that you don’t have to honor the Sabbath on Friday evening, you’re a fool.
“In that day shall there be a great mourning in Jerusalem, as the mourning of Hadadrimmon in the valley of Megiddon.” Armageddon, Har Megiddo, is saying the same thing as the valley of Megiddon.

The Lord told us to watch and to keep our garments on, and our garments are the righteousness of the saints. We often overlook what is necessary for our survival. “Ye blind guides, which strain at a gnat, and swallow a camel.” Many of you can swallow a camel: prophecy, yes Lord, the Euphrates drying up, you swallow it, it is big. But a gnat is small, and you choke on it: love your neighbor as yourself; Matthew 18, win your brother. You strain at the smaller things in the law and swallow the big things.

“Blessed are they that do his commandments, that they may have right to the tree of life, and may enter in through the gates into the city.” While you are busy swallowing down the greatness of the prophecies, you are choking on the commandments, the little things: love your neighbor as yourself, thou shalt not bear false witness. When the deacons came in, there were two years with no prophecy: get your house in order, learn the commandments, start with the milk. The milk benefited them. The dangers that happened to the disciples of Christ are going to happen again.

There is a balance; prophecy is important, but there is an order. “But he that giveth his mind to the law of the most High, and is occupied in the meditation thereof, will seek out the wisdom of all the ancient”: to understand the wisdom of the ancients you must understand God’s laws, because their parables are based on God’s laws. When the Sadducees asked Christ whose wife the woman with seven husbands would be, Christ took them back to the law in Deuteronomy 25. “And be occupied in prophecies”: first the law, then meditating on it, then the wisdom of the ancients, then prophecy. That is the order of understanding.

“He will keep the sayings of the renowned men”: the famous men, our forefathers. “And where subtil parables are, he will be there also”: because he meditated on God’s laws. “He will seek out the secrets of grave sentences, and be conversant in dark parables. He shall serve among great men, and appear before princes: he will travel through strange countries; for he hath tried the good and the evil among men.” That is where we are trying to bring you men: to aid us in traveling to strange and far countries. But your minds must be right; you must understand God’s laws.

“My son, if thou come to serve the Lord, prepare thy soul for temptation.” We usually explain it for the individual, but it extends from the individual to a marriage to a congregation: the three trials of faith. The most common temptations for an individual are sex and money.

The Matrix shows it: the woman in the red dress, and the brother lost focus; sex is how brothers get hemmed up. And Cypher, who wanted to be rich and to be someone important, and betrayed Morpheus, his brothers, for it. The love of money was the root of a lot of the foolishness: my business, my money, my hustle. Write it down, sex and money, because it ain’t the end; it is going to continue.

“And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil”: the evil of the temptation of sex or money. Satan can’t tempt you unless something is already in you: you cannot be tempted with a cigarette that was never your thing. Temptation, we are already told, is coming; lead us not into it means, Lord, don’t let us give in to the temptation, and deliver us from that evil.

“Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing”: your spirit says I can take it if it comes. “But the flesh is weak”: that carnal mind. You see the big smile, that girl is poison, and you ignore all the warning signs; you see an opportunity for financial gain and the scriptures get closed. Brothers will always be tempted with those two, sex and money.

“And thou shalt remember all the way which the Lord thy God led thee these forty years in the wilderness, to humble thee, and to prove thee”: to prove is to test. “To know what was in thine heart, whether thou wouldest keep his commandments, or no.” Everybody says I love the Lord; God says, Satan, send that sister over to him and see what happens. Suddenly she says you look like a movie star, and Satan has got you. Vice versa with the sisters.

“For the Lord your God proveth you, to know whether ye love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul.” God will allow you to be tested. Some tests we win and some we might lose, but when you lose, don’t run out of the truth: like Sirach says, if you are put down in the low estate, endure it and rise back up.

“And they were to prove Israel by them, to know whether they would hearken unto the commandments of the Lord.” The Most High is proving us, testing us constantly, and when you think the test doesn’t involve you, it is a test for you. Three years of videos, cleverly and craftily edited, about a personal business matter: it had nothing to do with you, yet some brothers in Europe said we’re leaving.

“He that passeth by, and meddleth with strife belonging not to him, is like one that taketh a dog by the ears.” Grab a dog by its ears and you get bit. You see a video that has nothing to do with you, you get upset, you have to say something, and you get bit: now you are out of the truth. The test was between those individuals, but all of us are being tested on how we apply the scripture: this has nothing to do with me, don’t meddle, I’ll fall back. Those that left failed the test, and they will never admit it.
Why they meddle: “It is an honour for a man to cease from strife”: mind his own business. “But every fool will be meddling.” Fools meddle in business that does not pertain to them, and they fall off.

Still on Revelation 16:15: he will come upon you like a thief; watch and have your garments on. David said, “Examine me, O Lord, and prove me; try my reins and my heart.” Test me. That is why Sirach said when you come to serve the Lord, prepare thy soul for temptation. God proves us according to our own lusts and desires, and these tests decide whether we win or lose. Either you win or you learn: lose means you left; learn means I fell, I’m getting back up, Lord, I’m staying in this truth and enduring to the end.

David said examine me, and Paul says, “Examine yourselves, whether ye be in the faith; prove your own selves.” When you come into this truth you should be able to identify your own hang-ups, weaknesses and emotional problems, so when you are tested you catch yourself: this is a test, I almost fell, Satan, you almost got me. “Know ye not your own selves, how that Jesus Christ is in you, except ye be reprobates?” I can’t prove you; you have to prove your own self. We thought we knew some people, and found out we never really knew them.

“For to this end also did I write, that I might know the proof of you, whether ye be obedient in all things”: whether you are obedient in all of God’s laws. “To whom ye forgive any thing, I forgive also”: the subject is forgiveness. “Lest Satan should get an advantage of us: for we are not ignorant of his devices.” One of Satan’s devices is unforgiveness. When you have that cold, bitter heart, Satan has got you. That is why Christ told Peter not seven times, but seventy times seven, and then explained the steps to win your brother back. It is not a foolish, I’ll just forgive you; you sit down with your brother.

“Moreover if thy brother shall trespass against thee, go and tell him his fault between thee and him alone: if he shall hear thee, thou hast gained thy brother.” The point of the whole thing is to gain your brother, to win him back. But one said, my point is not to gain you, my point is to entrap you in your words and make a video to embarrass you. Those are elements of Satan. When they can’t touch who you have become, they dig up your past.
“And it shall come to pass, that in all the land, saith the Lord, two parts therein shall be cut off and die; but the third shall be left therein.” The great city divided into three parts.

“And the heaven departed as a scroll when it is rolled together”: thermonuclear destruction. “And every mountain and island were moved out of their places.” All the mountains and islands will be moved out of their place.

The fifth angel pours his vial on the seat of the beast, and its kingdom is full of darkness while they gnaw their tongues for pain. The beast is the so-called white man. The place where he rules is the kingdom of darkness, Satan's realm, from which the Father delivers his people. The darkness translates to sin.

precepts.why: Some of y’all think when Christ comes back everybody is going to be happy and praise him; that’s a lie. “And they repented not to give him glory”: the nations are not going to submit.

What are these three unclean spirits like frogs? Politics, religion, and finance.

points: The first went, and poured out his vial upon the earth; and there fell a noisome and grievous sore upon the men which had the mark of the beast, and upon them which worshipped his image.
Noisome means foul smelling, harmful, noxious: a real nasty sore.
The key thing: the sore falls on the people that worship the image of the beast and have his mark. If it is only them, where are we? We are delivered.

The second angel poured out his vial upon the sea; and it became as the blood of a dead man: and every living soul died in the sea. This is talking about war on the sea, bombs going off in the ocean. This is Mystery Babylon being destroyed; the same plagues he sent on Egypt he is sending on America, and all of it comes in one hour.
The third angel poured out his vial upon the rivers and fountains of waters; and they became blood. When it says it became blood, it means it became poisonous; nobody can drink it.

Thou art righteous, O Lord, because thou hast judged thus. For they have shed the blood of saints and prophets, and thou hast given them blood to drink; for they are worthy. America will kill the saints and prophets here in the future, so the Lord gives America blood to drink: poisonous, radioactive water. Them that the blast does not incinerate die from noisome sores, and them that go trying to drink water die from drinking poisoned water.

The fifth angel poured out his vial upon the seat of the beast, which is America, and his kingdom was full of darkness; and they gnawed their tongues for pain, and blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores. They are feeling that darkness, and the sores go back to the first plague, the noisome sores. Same plague of darkness that was on Egypt.
A great voice out of the temple said to the seven angels, Go your ways, and pour out the vials of the wrath of God upon the earth. Now the sixth vial.

points: The sixth angel poured out his vial upon the great river Euphrates, and the water thereof was dried up, that the way of the kings of the east might be prepared. note.label: Armageddon: Islam and the Armies of the East

points: And he gathered them together into a place called in the Hebrew tongue Armageddon. Armageddon is a place. Read from the screen: Megiddo, from ancient Canaanite roots, is generally interpreted as a place of troops, or a rendezvous, a city of strategic military importance; Armageddon comes from Har Megiddo, mount of Megiddo. So Armageddon means the place of troops, where all the armies are gathered. Where is it? Megiddo is known today as Tel Megiddo, located in modern-day Israel at the western end of the Jezreel Valley, in northern Israel, renowned for its 5,000 year history and famous as the biblical location of Armageddon. So Armageddon is modern-day Israel; that is where the armies are going to go, and that is where the one they call the Mahdi is going to go. When you read Judges 1:27-28, Megiddo was one of the lands we took from the Canaanites; it is part of the land of Israel.

note.label: Armageddon: Islam and the Armies of the East

points: The sixth angel poured out his vial upon the great river Euphrates, and the water thereof was dried up, that the way of the kings of the east might be prepared. Photos and a news article were shown of parts of the Euphrates river drying up already. Best believe we are in Bible times.

Three unclean spirits like frogs: write this down. Out of the mouth of the dragon: politics. Out of the mouth of the beast: economics. Out of the mouth of the false prophet: religion, Christianity. They are the spirits of devils, which go forth unto the kings of the earth and of the whole world, to gather them to the battle of that great day of God Almighty: meaning Armageddon. The three reasons all nations will fight are political reasons, economics, and religion.
The fifth vial fills the beast's kingdom with darkness and pain, yet they repent not.
The great city was divided into three parts before God gave her the cup of his wrath. Civil war comes first, then the great hail of nuclear destruction.

note.label: Civil War & the Son of Perdition

points: The sixth angel dried up the Euphrates to prepare the way of the kings of the east, and the Euphrates is drying up now.
Three unclean spirits come from the dragon, the beast and the false prophet: politics, the American financial system and Christianity. They gather the kings of the earth to battle.

“And I heard a great voice out of the temple saying to the seven angels, Go your ways, and pour out the vials of the wrath of God upon the earth”: these seven angels are going to wreak havoc upon the earth. The seven vials represent war. Christ said there shall be wars and rumors of wars, and in this chapter we see both: wars, and the rumor of a war to come.

“And the first went, and poured out his vial upon the earth; and there fell a noisome and grievous sore upon the men which had the mark of the beast, and upon them which worshipped his image.” To know who has the mark of the beast and worships his image, go back to Revelation 14.

“And the second angel poured out his vial upon the sea; and it became as the blood of a dead man: and every living soul died in the sea”: that goes into wars that take place at sea. The waters are blood because of fallout, waste, chemical and biological warfare that poisons the waters so that fish die and men die, like the nerve gas dropped in Syria. Many times in war they poison the waters. If you have never been in the military you don’t understand war: our people in the ghetto think they can overthrow something, and all he has to do is cut the water off. We don’t understand strategy.
“And the third angel poured out his vial upon the rivers and fountains of waters; and they became blood”: many of these chapters say the same thing; some just give a little more detail than others.

“Thou art righteous, O Lord, which art, and wast, and shalt be, because thou hast judged thus”: which art and was and shall be, that is why he is called the Ancient of Days. He is from everlasting to everlasting.

“For they have shed the blood of saints and prophets, and thou hast given them blood to drink; for they are worthy.” That is a heavy point. This is talking about Babylon, so why does it say America has shed the blood of saints and prophets? Because the Israelites who killed the prophets are here, and the prophets that rose up here were slaughtered here.
“And thou hast given them blood to drink; for they are worthy”: God says this place is worthy to drink blood. To drink blood is to die: America is worthy to be destroyed.
“Even so, Lord God Almighty, true and righteous are thy judgments.”

“And the fourth angel poured out his vial upon the sun; and power was given unto him to scorch men with fire”: this fire is the bombs burning people up. When the vial was poured out on the sun, not only was the wisdom removed; there was so much war and fire it was destroying people.

“And men were scorched with great heat, and blasphemed the name of God”: these are wars that have come and gone, and some still occurring today. “Which hath power over these plagues: and they repented not to give him glory”: that is the part to get to. Many times we think war will make people change their lives; the Bible says they repented not. These nations that war and fight don’t change their ways.

“And the fifth angel poured out his vial upon the seat of the beast”: the seat of the beast is Babylon, this place right here. “And his kingdom was full of darkness”: that darkness is confusion. In Daniel 2 the last kingdom on earth is partly iron and partly clay; they mingle themselves with the seed of men, but they shall not cleave, as oil does not mix with water. In this kingdom all nations are here, and each race pushes its own culture to the front: the Chinese, the Arab, everybody, except our people. We are the only race that wants to be multicultural.

“And they gnawed their tongues for pain, And blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores, and repented not of their deeds”: don’t think this place is going to turn around and change its ways. Even with all their apologies, we apologize for slavery: that’s a lie, they don’t mean it.

“And the sixth angel poured out his vial upon the great river Euphrates; and the water thereof was dried up, that the way of the kings of the east might be prepared”: write this down. Verse 12 makes reference to the coming war, what people call World War III. Christ said there shall be wars and rumors of wars. There have been wars, like America bombing seven nations; a rumor of war is the major war that is in everyone’s mouth but has not occurred yet. Everyone has been talking about the last, final war for centuries. Verses 1 to 11, the scorching, the poisoning of the waters, are smaller wars leading up to verse 12, the preparation for the great and final war.

The New York Times reported it in 2009: Iraq suffers as the Euphrates River dwindles, strangled by the water policies of its neighbors Turkey and Syria, a two-year drought and years of misuse, and it could soon be half of what it was. You are living in prophecy and don’t know it, because in American culture we live in a bubble; America’s news is censored. We are not in the first empire, or the second, or the third; we are in the last empire, at the end, as the Euphrates dries up. This is all getting ready for Armageddon.

So you can play games and make your little videos to embarrass people, but you are going to die. You changed the doctrine, no more Sabbath, we’ll keep it at sunrise: die. My job is to warn you; a watchman’s job is to warn the people, not to be liked.

“And I saw three unclean spirits like frogs come out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet”: at work they tell you not to talk about two things, religion and politics. The unclean spirit out of the mouth of the dragon is politics. Out of the mouth of the beast is commerce, trade and business: the IMF and world economics, buying and selling. Out of the mouth of the false prophet is religion, Christianity to be specific.

The dragon speaks through his media: he controls the perception of the masses through his mouth. In the video every news channel had the same message, word for word; it all comes from one source. Once they’ve got your perception, they’ve got you. That is why on the street people all say the same thing, color doesn’t matter: they got it from TV.

“For they are the spirits of devils”: politics is a spirit of devils, religion is a spirit of devils, and world economics is a spirit of devils, because in business they deal unjustly. “Working miracles, which go forth unto the kings of the earth and of the whole world, to gather them to the battle of that great day of God Almighty”: those are the three things that are going to make this world pop off, the accumulation of all that we are seeing. That is what they will fight over. This is why the scriptures tell us to watch as well as pray; you can’t watch if you are looking at sports all day.

“Behold, I come as a thief”: that is a heavy verse. You are not going to know when Christ is coming. We just had an interview, and the Edomite kept asking when Christ is coming; he said it would not be published, he was working for an elite group of men. He asked how we know where to go in the earth, about our numbers, about the Daughters of Sarah: all this is strategy, trying to assess Israel United in Christ. People are watching. The things happening through the IUIC schools are not by accident; they are by design.

“Blessed is he that watcheth”: you watch by studying the scriptures and watching what is happening in world events, the prophecies. “And keepeth his garments”: keep your garments of righteousness, keep God’s laws, keep the commandments. “Lest he walk naked, and they see his shame”: lest you walk in the midst of sin and everyone sees your shame. You left the truth of keeping the commandments because of an edited video; now you teach that water saves you, that chicken and turkey are unclean. The test came and proved you naked.

Prophecy is good, it is excellent, and it is how we watch and know the time and season. But while going through the prophecies we often overlook what is necessary to survive, and that is why we stay on verse 15. The meat is in it.

“And he gathered them together into a place called in the Hebrew tongue Armageddon”: Armageddon is Megiddo. Har means mountain or hill: the mountain of Megiddo. That goes back to 2 Kings 23:29, the valley of Megiddo, a range of mountains with a valley at the bottom; they just spelled it slightly differently.

“And the seventh angel poured out his vial into the air; and there came a great voice out of the temple of heaven, from the throne, saying, It is done. And there were voices, and thunders, and lightnings; and there was a great earthquake, such as was not since men were upon the earth, so mighty an earthquake, and so great.”

“And the great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell: and great Babylon came in remembrance before God, to give unto her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath”: that is all God’s judgments coming on this place.
“And every island fled away, and the mountains were not found”: those of you who come from the various islands, don’t think you are going to escape there. The islands will be no protection.
“And there fell upon men a great hail out of heaven, every stone about the weight of a talent: and men blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail; for the plague thereof was exceeding great.”

“And the fifth angel poured out his vial upon the seat of the beast; and his kingdom was full of darkness; and they gnawed their tongues for pain”: a lot of us must be saying "I don't know why he's saying that." I believe what this Bible says. Watch this.
“And blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores, and repented not of their deeds.”
